summary: AfriYouth Innovation Labs tracks longitudinal indicators to ensure that every youth fellowship, research study, and enterprise grant translates into measurable socio-economic resilience.

metrics.label: Young African Leaders Engaged
metrics.detail: Participated in research cohorts, design sprints, policy consultations, and innovation labs across the continent.

metrics.label: African Countries Active
metrics.detail: Direct grassroots field operations, university research nodes, and regional policymaking partnerships.

metrics.label: Policy Frameworks Influenced
metrics.detail: Adopted by municipal councils, national ministries, and regional economic commissions with youth evidence.

metrics.label: Catalytic Capital Mobilized
metrics.detail: Equity-free grants, research stipends, and venture co-investments unlocked for youth-led solutions.

metrics.label: Youth Enterprises Incubated
metrics.detail: High-survival social ventures and civic tech tools solving public delivery bottlenecks.

metrics.label: Program Survival & Scale Rate
metrics.detail: Ventures and policy taskforces sustaining operations 24 months post-lab participation.

pillars.title: Evidence That Shapes Governance
pillars.description: Our researchers don't write reports for dusty bookshelves. Every policy paper connects to a parliamentary sponsor, an African Union desk, or a municipal mayor's office, resulting in tangible statutory changes like youth startup acts and municipal green procurement guidelines.

pillars.title: Ventures That Employ & Deliver
pillars.description: By grounding youth entrepreneurs in human-centered design before providing catalytic seed capital, AfriYouth enterprises achieve an 91% 2-year survival rate—more than double the regional SME average.

pillars.title: Grassroots Democratic Agency
pillars.description: From informal urban settlement sanitation in Nairobi to agro-pastoral water distribution in the Sahel, our HCD studios center the citizens most impacted as lead designers of public solutions.

methodology.title: Evidence-First Impact Methodology
methodology.description: AfriYouth adheres to gold-standard mixed-method monitoring, combining randomized survey samples, qualitative ethnographic tracking, and 3-year longitudinal career and venture milestone monitoring.
